pages.text: The Blood-Infused Spellbook channels Life Essence to enhance spellcasting capabilities. This hybrid tome consumes LP to boost spell power and mana regeneration, bridging Iron's Spells magic with Blood Magic's sacrificial arts.

$(blood)Blood-Powered Spellbook$()$(br2)Passively consume LP from your Blood Network to fuel your magical studies. The Blood-Infused Spellbook provides powerful bonuses when held in your inventory while you cast spells.

pages.title: Creating the Book
pages.text: To create a Blood-Infused Spellbook, you must perform a ritual at the Blood Altar. You will need:$(br2)$(li)A $(item)Spellbook$() from Iron's Spells 'n Skills$(li)A $(blood)Tier 4 or higher$() Blood Altar$(li)A $(blood)Weak Blood Orb$() or better in the altar$(li)At least $(blood)20,000 LP$() in the altar$(br2)With these requirements met, simply right-click the Blood Altar with the spellbook in hand. The spellbook will be consumed and transformed.

pages.title: Abilities
pages.text: $(bold)Passive Bonuses:$()$(li)$(blood)+10%% Spell Power$()$(li)$(blood)+25%% Mana Regeneration$()$(li)$(blood)+5%% Cooldown Reduction$()$(br)$(italic)LP Cost: 10 LP/second$()$(br2)$(bold)Active Benefits:$()$(li)$(blood)10%% Mana Cost Reduction$() on all spells$(li)$(blood)Overdraw Mana:$() Consume $(blood)100 LP$() per missing mana point to cast anyway.

pages.title: Requirements
pages.text: To use the Blood-Infused Spellbook, you must have:$(br2)$(li)$(mod)Iron's Spellbooks$() installed$(li)An active $(l:bloodmagic:altar/binding)Soul Network$() with sufficient LP$(br2)The book functions from any inventory slot and does not need to be held.
